statistical_contract.overall_tau: existing mean pairwise Kendall rank concordance across valid events within a patient
statistical_contract.within_tau: same readout within each frozen cluster; event pairs, not independent patients
statistical_contract.channel_sd: per-channel population SD over participating events, divided by n_channels-1; median across channels
statistical_contract.comparison: descriptive patient-exemplar comparison only; no cohort inference
statistical_contract.caution: rank ranges, participation and mode mixtures differ among patients
